landing.hero.badge: Cache read/write pricing, automatic failover and reseller rebates
landing.hero.sub: An OpenAI-compatible protocol aggregating multiple upstream providers, with per-token metering and billing. Channels fail over automatically on errors, while keys and quotas are governed in one place — leave routing, billing and operations complexity to the gateway.

landing.section.features.title: Everything a gateway should do
landing.section.features.desc: From routing to billing to audit — the full multi-model pipeline, without stitching scripts together.
landing.section.quickstart.title: Ship your first request in four steps
landing.section.quickstart.desc: Keep your existing SDK — just swap base_url and the model name.
landing.section.pricing.title: Per-token billing, transparent prices
landing.section.pricing.desc: The table below is the live model catalog enabled on this gateway, synced with the console's Models page.
landing.features.compatible.title: OpenAI-compatible API
landing.features.compatible.desc: Swap base_url in one line and keep your existing SDK — /v1/chat/completions and /v1/models work out of the box, with native streaming SSE.
landing.features.failover.title: Automatic multi-channel failover
landing.features.failover.desc: On upstream 5xx / 429 errors, traffic fails over to the next channel, routed by priority and weight; channels are disabled automatically past a failure threshold and an alert is pushed.
landing.features.protocols.title: Bidirectional support for three protocols
landing.features.protocols.desc: Native OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini protocols convert in both directions, with image inputs and streaming deltas passed through correctly.
landing.features.metering.title: Precise per-token metering
landing.features.metering.desc: Input, output, cache read and cache write are priced in four separate columns and booked per request, with aggregation by model / channel / user and CSV export.
landing.features.byok.title: BYOK bring-your-own channels
landing.features.byok.desc: Create channels with your own upstream key — routed above platform channels, calls never spend your platform balance, and keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM throughout.
landing.features.governance.title: Key and permission governance
landing.features.governance.desc: API keys are shown in plaintext only once and stored as SHA-256, with quota / cost / RPM / expiry limits and a full audit trail.
landing.cta.title: Ready to get started?
landing.cta.desc: Sign up and go — create a key and send your first request within a minute. No sales call needed.
landing.quickstart.steps.register.title: Sign up and sign in
landing.quickstart.steps.register.desc: Create an account to enter the console; admins can top up credits or issue redemption codes.
landing.quickstart.steps.topup.title: Top up balance
landing.quickstart.steps.topup.desc: Top up credits on demand — balance is credited instantly, every bill entry is queryable, CSV export supported.
landing.quickstart.steps.createKey.title: Create an API Key
landing.quickstart.steps.createKey.desc: The key is shown in plaintext only once; set quota, cost cap, RPM and expiry.
landing.quickstart.steps.baseUrl.title: Set base_url
landing.quickstart.steps.baseUrl.desc: Point your existing SDK's base_url to the gateway and pass the model name through as-is.
